response: Ensure the boathouse is aired out to promote a healthy environment for all. Airing out the boathouse helps prevent the buildup of moisture and mold, which can be harmful to both people and animals. During this process, it's also a great opportunity to check for any issues with the lanterns or rivets, ensuring they are in good condition. The mortar between the walls should be cleaned and inspected to maintain structural integrity. Regular airing out not only improves air quality but also helps keep the lanterns and rivets in optimal working order. Make sure to keep the mortar well-maintained to prevent any damage to the structure.
